provenance.notes: Only 5 standards across a very wide range (6.5 kDa–669 kDa) on a resin optimized for large complexes — the log-linear fit is noticeably worse here than for the other two columns and can be off by 30–50% near the ends of the range (thyroglobulin, aldolase). Digitized from published Cytiva chromatogram figures (pixel-position analysis), not a real lab-measured curve. Treat as order-of-magnitude only.
